title: Remove the Wasm reflex sandbox and pillar cell server from core
goal: Vision: V-9. CEO direction 2026-11-18: core under 25,000 lines; keep the install channel and start with the plug-in sandbox. susi-vendor-wasmtime (the fuel-metered Wasmi reflex sandbox), its client susi-native-client and susi-abi's cell_server have no caller in core: the root crate only re-exports the sandbox as susi::native, and every user is in Susi Commercial Apps. Once Commercial Apps owns both with their tests (T-CLAUDESANDBOX-1), delete core's copies, the re-export and their lock entries; keep the ABI's cell, syscall, swarm and wire contracts; correct every document and check that names them; and lower COMPLETE_SOCKET_CEILING to the new measure.
